lay down.meaning: Thiết lập các quy tắc hoặc thủ tục.
lay down.example: The rules of the sport were laid down early in the nineteenth century.
He got laid down in a turf war about supplying drugs.

lay into.meaning: Chỉ trích một cách tức giận.
lay into.example: His partner laid into him when he arrived two hours late..

lay on.example: They laid on a buffet lunch at the conference.

lay out.example: They laid out thousands of pounds on their wedding reception.

labor of love.meaning: Công việc làm vì đam mê.
labor of love.example: Writing her novel was a labor of love; she spent years perfecting it.

lay someone off.meaning: Sa thải (vì lý do kinh tế, tổ chức lại).
lay someone off.example: He was laid off last month because the company had to downsize.

last but not least.meaning: Cuối cùng nhưng không kém phần quan trọng.
last but not least.example: And last but not least, I'd like to thank all the volunteers for their hard work.

last-ditch effort.meaning: Nỗ lực cuối cùng, cố gắng vớt vát.
last-ditch effort.example: In a last-ditch effort to save their home, they organized a fundraising event.

laugh all the way to the bank.term: Laugh all the way to the bank
laugh all the way to the bank.meaning: Kiếm được món hời lớn một cách dễ dàng.
laugh all the way to the bank.example: After selling his startup, he was laughing all the way to the bank.
laugh all the way to the bank.ipa: /lɑːf ɔːl ðə weɪ tə ðə bæŋk/

lay an egg.meaning: Thất bại thảm hại (thường trong biểu diễn hoặc ra mắt).
lay an egg.example: The new product launch laid an egg; customers were not interested.

lay down the law.meaning: Đặt ra luật lệ, ra oai.
lay down the law.example: The boss had to lay down the law after too many employees started arriving late.

last straw.meaning: Giọt nước tràn ly, điều cuối cùng khiến sự chịu đựng bùng nổ.
last straw.example: When he arrived two hours late again, it was the last straw and she fired him.
